notes.title: Devlog - May 17, 2025 - Shattermist, Adding lots of unlockables and Crew Logs!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! It's been a bit longer since our last devlog, but we've been hard at work adding new features and polishing existing ones!

[h3]Shattermist[/h3]
Shattermist randomly "detonates" like lightning, damaging enemies and the player. Use it to your advantage!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45540434/616fd1a67960536ac32e5ecf3bd76a8942531282.gif[/img]

[h3]Unlockables[/h3]
Many stat upgrades, Circuits and Mods are unlocked by completing various feats in combat. For example, completing 3 Sectors without taking any damage can unlock a new Circuit for use!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45540434/df1293c58a54604b935a03e321a5916ea0e1c41a.gif[/img]

[h3]CRT scanline FX[/h3]
Like retro fx? If not, they're completely toggleable in the Settings menu!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45540434/290035a357eb5694cb1c8db12565a323d0afdea7.gif[/img]

[h3]Maps[/h3]
There are now 60+ maps for pilots to clean up while rescuing the crew! Each has been hand designed with touch of procedural generation to keep things fresh.

[h3]Crew Logs[/h3]
Crew Logs can now drop in certain situations. These contain entries by the various missing crew members detailing their various missions, ship info, mission updates and more!

[h3]Other (Demo is WIP!)[/h3]
Lots of bug fixes and polish applied as we work towards a public demo!

Cheers!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45540434/625f16adbc8e32ea415836353713d45a7f9c20db.png[/img]

notes.title: Devlog - May 2, 2025 - New Boss Moves, New Enemies!
notes.content:
[h3]Boss Upgrades[/h3]
Hivemind has a few new tricks. Exhibit A, corner map lasers when firing the Proboscis Beam:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45540434/64974dc2c3cbf3d446e0664044b100c59645385b.gif[/img]

Destroying the new Fog Machine enemy will clear up a map, making it easier to see!

[h3]Missing Crew Members[/h3]
You can now see the remaining missing crew members to rescue on the main menu. Get to work!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45540434/625f16adbc8e32ea415836353713d45a7f9c20db.png[/img]

notes.title: Devlog - April 19, 2025 - New Thermal Effects, Enemies and Revamped Weaponry
notes.content:
[h2]Revamped Weaponry[/h2]
To help keep a focus on temperature-based weaponry the Acidity weapon is now called Splitfrost! It's a slower firing cold weapon with wide, short range that deals frostbite damage instead of acid damage!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45540434/babb1b285536fbb6d8df6e7327917f817663b709.gif[/img]

[h2]New Temperature Effects[/h2]
This week we added several new temperature effects to weaponry!

[h3]Frostbite[/h3]
Stacks on an enemy and then does a massive single amount of damage.

[h3]Scorch[/h3]
Reduces enemy armor effectiveness on each hit. Super useful for tearing down highly armored foes.

[h3]Brittle[/h3]
Increases the chances of dealing a critical hit per shot. This stacks, allowing each hit to be more likely to be a critical hit!

[h3]Blaze[/h3]
Once an enemy's Blaze level exceeds Blaze threshold the enemy will emit a heated extreme temperature zone. This can be used to Superheat your ship or have other effects!

All of these are upgradable stats!

[h2]Temperature Resistant Enemies[/h2]
We're in the process of designing more enemies that are resistant to heat or cold effects. For example:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45540434/c83bca5182ffa36c2524854c66630e2cec32dd55.gif[/img]

[h3]Bug fixes and smaller changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Updated Dad's Old Ship look to be more sleek
[*] Rebalanced a bunch of player weapons with the new stats
[*] Rebalanced enemy armor
[*] Player's bullet shield can now block all bullets while active regardless of temperature. Temperature-specific was too much to make the player keep track of in-game. This is now upgradable!
[*] Buffed the player ship speed stat so the player can move even faster
[*] Reduced the amount asteroids that can spawn in a room
[/list]


Cheers!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45540434/625f16adbc8e32ea415836353713d45a7f9c20db.png[/img]

notes.title: Devlog - April 11, 2025 - The Sectors Update
notes.content:
[h2]Major Update to Sectors[/h2]

We overhauled the way Sectors are created so they're created by hand with just a touch of procedural generation. Prior to this, Sectors were mostly empty rooms with enemies spawned in at partially randomized places. 

Now, instead of having empty areas to start with we can have much more fun creating cool, challenging maps like this!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45540434/a765c9357610e33aadc42f6ef94f278674d21472.png[/img]

Or this:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45540434/4d548b54488a785e2bf324fd6019d1f7322dcf79.png[/img]

Or this!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45540434/7be2a6b8e6d4215201d6846a01543c0a88f8e8fc.png[/img]

[h2]New Features[/h2]

[h2]Thermal Enemy Weaponry[/h2]
Enemies can now fire cold, hot and neutral temperature bullets!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45540434/6f2441ce9546650127d790e4de4093397f1397aa.gif[/img]

[h2]Thermal Shields[/h2]
Your ship can now use it's current temperature to create a bullet shield! This can be used to block enemy bullets of specific temperatures. Using your bullet shield moves your ship temperature towards neutral quickly so use it wisely!

A cold shield is created when your ship temperature is chilled and a heat shield is created when your ship temperature is heated! More on this soon as we continue to polish it. 

[h2]Additional Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Boost ability can now be upgraded and is used like Dash
[*] Shrunk the hurtboxes on player ships to make it a bit harder for the player to get hit
[*] Player ship temperature is no longer reset at the end of a sector so it can be carried into the next sector
[*] Updated bounce weaponry so it can't get stuck on the wall in some cases
[*] Enemies now "sleep" for just a moment when player enters so the player doesn't get attacked when portaling into a sector
[*] Adjusted the positioning of some player ship weapons to make them easier to use
[/list]

notes.title: Devlog - April 4, 2025 - Pulse weapon, Chillweaver enemy
notes.content:
[h2]New Weapon[/h2]
[h3]PULSE[/h3]
Deals fiery waves of damage that go through enemies. Push your enemies around at higher ranks of this weapon!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45540434/386eadd1643dd9a06119f80db766cea9e4afbce2.gif[/img]


[h2]New Enemies[/h2]
[h3]CHILLWEAVER[/h3]
An icey spider who spits sludge at the player when they get too close. Watch out for the webs too. Resistant to cold damage.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45540434/36fdf2c3bf7f28cb30f25aa14e47acd2169cc07e.gif[/img]


[h3]Feature updates[/h3]
Better player ship handling - crispier movement so the player "slides" around much less
Added more dynamic lighting to enemies and weapons
Cleaned up the visible area outside of the playable map so it's easier to focus on the playable area
Made damage the player deals more dynamic (more on this coming soon!)

[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
Fixed a few bugs with UI layout spacing in menus
Fixed Player ship movement bugs to decrease time to stopped movement



Cheers!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45540434/625f16adbc8e32ea415836353713d45a7f9c20db.png[/img]

notes.title: Devlog - March 28, 2025 - New Enemies, New Upgradable Stats and Balancing
notes.content:
[h2]New Enemies[/h2]
[h3]A new enemy with a few variants[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45540434/88230c02bf78dbbb0814ec22784c43577ac9cdd1.gif[/img]

Frozen enemies now explode into ice shrapnel when destroyed. The amount of ice shrapnel created and how much damage it does when colliding with other enemies can be upgraded with a new System stat!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45540434/5a0b2be064796b4ed592d09c5f7c008bb3f7bd8e.gif[/img]

Overheated enemies now burst a wave of heat when destroyed. This heats up the ship temperature of nearby enemies. The radius of the blast can be upgraded with a new System stat!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45540434/294e9bedd37f811c6a04a81aa096d7606f4b35ef.gif[/img]

[h3]Changes to existing enemies[/h3]
[list]
[*] Elite Mosquito Nests now fire slow zones instead of just spawning mosquito enemies
[*] Black holes are now Magnetic Fields and don't cause health damage. Objects gradually move towards them - like the Player or bullets.
[/list]
[h3]New Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] Temperature resistant enemies are now in the game! These enemies cannot be frozen overheated depending on their resistance type.
[/list]
[h3]Balancing Updates[/h3]
[list]
[*] XP is now automatically given when most enemies are destroyed instead of having to collect it. Added a new System stat that increases the chances of bonus XP dropping when an enemy is destroyed.
[*] Changed the weapon wheel so weapons are equipped on hovering over the element in the player's cargo bay instead of having to click. "Hold, Hover, Release" instead of "Hold, Release, Click". [i]Thanks for the feedback on that![/i]
[/list]

Check out a video of some of the new additions on our youtube channel:
https://youtube.com/shorts/0uzOJWsfBok?si=y7BrGngLml1QvyzG

Also here's a preview of the Titan's Rest theme track:
https://youtube.com/shorts/oyYiQi0Qmcg?si=CdMrzUiatR3CraT8


Cheers!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45540434/625f16adbc8e32ea415836353713d45a7f9c20db.png[/img]

notes.title: Devlog - March 22, 2025
notes.content:
[b]New Features & Content[/b]  
[list]
[*] [b]Rescue Goal v2[/b] – Major overhaul of wave creation to dynamically inject rescue waves when conditions are met. A new [b]damage-free wave tracker[/b] was added to trigger rescue waves after a set number of damage-free waves.  
[*] [b]New Unlockable Ships[/b] – [b]The Dart[/b] is now an unlockable ship! 
[/list]
[h2]Rescue System Improvements[/h2]  
[list]
[*] Upon rescue, the ally warps out via portal and the goal updates to [b]destroy all remaining enemies[/b] with a log message confirming the ally has been rescued.  
[*] [b]Recolored "rescue wave" portal [/b] to make it stand out more.
[*] Rescue waves are now [b]excluded[/b] from mid-boss (wave 10) and session-ending (wave 20) portals to prevent conflicts.  
[/list]
[h2]New Enemies & Obstacles[/h2]  
[list]
[*] [b]Healing Bot Enemy[/b] – Restores health to allies and removes temperature stagger effects.  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45540434/32a1a4ad46f36be896ae1ab9f92deaf34e595759.gif[/img]
[*] [b]Credit Thief Enemy[/b] – Steals loose credits and drops credits when destroyed.  
[*] [b]Nebula Fog Obstacle[/b] – Dynamic fog that affects visibility on the map!  
[/list]
[h2]Weapon Updates[/h2]  
[list]
[*] [b]Electricity Weapon[/b] – Fires a electrical orb that tethers the player to enemies. Higher ranks allow the electrical tether to be swept across other enemies for damage!
[*] [b]Pulse Weapon[/b] – New design in progress!  
[*] [b]Cryo Weapon Adjustments[/b] – Now has a [b]shorter range[/b] initially but can be upgraded.  
[*] [b]General Balancing[/b] – Reduced cooldowns for piercing, chemicalx, and acidity weapons.  
[/list]
[h2]New System Upgrades[/h2] 
[list]
[*] Increased ship speed, longer enemy stagger from extreme temps.  
[/list]
[h2]Gameplay & Balance Tweaks[/h2]  
[list]
[*] [b]Increased Enemy Variety[/b] – A wider variety of enemies appear earlier to keep things fresh.
[*] [b]Stationary Turret Balancing[/b] – Should spawn a bit less to prevent overwhelming the player. 
[/list] 
[h2]Bug Fixes & Optimizations[/h2]  
[list]
[*] Fixed [b]various portal spawn issues[/b] related to wave 20, exit portals, and rescue portals.  
[*] Fixed [b]visual bugs[/b] like nebula fog density, low visibility overlay ordering, and extreme temp zone vfx being too noisy on screen.  
[*] Fixed [b]AI pathing issues[/b] with the Destroyer and Hivemind where they'd get stuck in some situations
[*] Fixed some collision bugs including bullets sticking to black holes and enemies overlapping when spawning.  
[/list]

[h2]Other Updates[/h2]  
[list]
[*] [b]Trailer Progress[/b] – First trailer completed!  
[/list]


That's all for now, Pilots! [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45540434/625f16adbc8e32ea415836353713d45a7f9c20db.png[/img]
